notes.title: Game launch error
notes.content:
There was a problem that the game did not run normally because the current library name was previously written as Lightfall.

In the process of fixing this issue, we encountered an issue that required us to reinstall the game.
If the game does not run, please reinstall it.
sorry.

notes.title: Hotfix - 2023.02.10 (2)
notes.content:
Hello! Third bug fix is complete!

1. Troubleshooting Sound Settings Not Applied
2. Solve the problem of reversing gravity in the laser map part and skipping the mask map.

Additional punt patches have also been made.
1. More tutorials have been added.
2. If you look at the first laser cut scene, it doesn't happen after that.

If there is a problem in the future, I will fix it quickly.
Thank you!

notes.title: Hotfix - 2023.02.10
notes.content:
This is the second hot fix!
1. Fixed a bug in which an object falling from the interior section of the building would die if it touched it even though it did not fall.
2. I fixed the bug that sounds the loudest even though I adjusted the sound in the settings.

If we find another bug, we'll fix it quickly!
Thank you!

notes.title: Hotfix - 2023.02.09
notes.content:
1. There is a place that doesn't die even if it falls off the map, so I corrected it.
2. Improved candidate selection effectiveness.

If we find a bug in the future, we will fix it as soon as possible.
Thank you!

notes.title: 게임 제목 변경 공지
notes.content:
Hello! We're Team Escape.

I'm here to tell you that the game title has been changed from LightFall to ALPO: Way to home.

Bishop games released a game named Lightfall before us, and we belatedly recognized this and this problem occurred.

Currently, the title of the game has been changed, but the title image has not yet been changed yet.
I will change it as soon as possible so that it doesn't get confused.

Thank you.
